task: H.E.X portrait personality edits — motion delegate subset

review_protocol.input_inspection: All four runtime portraits viewed before editing. Runtime and reference originals had matching SHA-256 file hashes.
review_protocol.output_inspection: Each generated output visually inspected at full portrait presentation before selection; selected generated PNG copied byte-for-byte and copy SHA-256 verified.
review_protocol.background: opaque warm parchment preserved by request
review_protocol.pixel_identity_limit: Visual invariants reviewed; generation may redraw local pixel texture and does not guarantee bit-identical non-expression pixels.
review_protocol.batch_expression_review: Grace: curious/delighted parted smile; Haara: vigilant closed unsmiling mouth; H. Lenee: furrowed determined focus; Sai Laas: crooked toothy delight. Expressions are intentionally distinct.

portraits.rationale: Airy duelist: open curiosity and delighted attention distinguish quick responsiveness from a generic smug grin.
portraits.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: H.E.X character-selection portrait, expressive retro pixel-art chest-up illustration.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: Grace Reava's current approved portrait. Change only her expression and the slightest chin attitude, preserving this exact female sylph identity and composition.
Primary request: make Grace openly curious and delighted, as an attentive airy duelist who has noticed an interesting opening. Lift her chin only slightly; open her green eyes with attentive interest and gently lift her brows. Give her a small genuinely delighted parted-lip smile, warm and inquisitive rather than a knowing smirk, smugness, or a large laugh. The expression should read through clear, charming pixel clusters at portrait-thumbnail size.
Preserve: her exact youthful feminine head structure, warm light skin tone, green iris color, short tousled teal hair, pointed ears, four existing translucent pale-cyan wings, dark green and gold high-collared outfit and capelet, all existing clasps and garment shapes, chest-up framing, three-quarter viewing angle, proportions, lighting, established green/teal/gold palette, dark pixel contour, and warm parchment background. Preserve relative head size and the existing crop; do not turn this into a different person or a realistic painting.
Style: retain the input's handcrafted retro pixel clusters and limited shaded material groups. Facial expressiveness comes from eyebrows, eyelids, cheeks and mouth only; no smooth airbrushed face or beauty makeover.
Avoid: generic smirk, stern frown, flirting pose, closed sleepy eyes, altered anatomy or age, new ornaments, new props, weapons, spells, particles, symbols, letters, captions, text, logos, watermark, extra characters. Output one square portrait, not a sheet.
portraits.review: Selected first pass. Raised attentive brows, more open green eyes and a small parted delighted smile clearly replace the original mild knowing smile. Chin attitude is slightly lifted without a visibly changed skull shape. Teal hair, pointed ears, pale-cyan wings, green/gold clothing and chest-up parchment composition remain visually consistent.
